newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells only 10 trln lira of 2-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells only 10 trln lira of 2-yr bonds.

text.p: Turkey sold a small amount of two-year, inflation-indexed bonds on Thursday although the risk premium was unchanged from the April 8 auction where it sold 133 trillion lira of similar bonds at the same risk premium.
There will be three-month coupon (interest) payments on the bonds.
Banks will pay 9.9 trillion lira to the Treasury for the auction on Friday. The Treasury repaid 34.7 trillion for maturing bonds on Thursday.
Bankers await a new bond auction for May 7 when the Treasury has to repay 130 trillion lira of t-bill maturities.
